metadata.title: Formal main term, local densities, and repeated-side closure
metadata.claim_status: Exact local-density algebra and repeated-side nonexistence; formal leading term conditional on a uniform lattice remainder.

fixed_modulus_volume.moduli: a|h, b|r, c|s, pairwise coprime, supported on primes 1 mod4
fixed_modulus_volume.odd_prime_density: For p not dividing bc use 1-1/p^2; for p^e||b or p^e||c the divisibility-plus-coprimality density is p^(-e)(1-1/p), producing the relative factor p/(p+1).

two_adic_density.both_r_s_odd: Residue mass 1/4 and h-length factor 2, contribution 1/2.
two_adic_density.opposite_parity: Residue mass 1/2 and even-h factor 1, contribution 1/2.

fixed_modulus_volume.archimedean_sector: The sector 0<r<s has angular width pi/4; radial integration of 1/(r^2+s^2) contributes (pi/8) log B.
fixed_modulus_volume.formal_fixed_modulus_term: V_{a,b,c}(B)=(B/(pi*a*b*c))*rho(b*c)*[log(B/(a*max(b,c)^2))]_+ plus a lower logarithmic term, for fixed a,b,c.
fixed_modulus_volume.unweighted_check: At a=b=c=1 this gives (1/pi) B log B, matching the finite parameter-point normalization trend.

interpretation: 2/(q^s-1) assigns q-powers to the h-modulus a.
Each of b and c contributes 2q/((q+1)(q^s-1)), including rho(q)=q/(q+1).
modulus_singularity.factorization: prod F_q(s)=zeta(s)^3 L(s,chi_4)^3 H(s), with H holomorphic and nonzero at s=1.

logarithmic_degree.log_simplex: With x=log a, y=log b, z=log c and L=log B, integral_{x+2max(y,z)<L}(L-x-2max(y,z)) dx dy dz = L^4/48.
logarithmic_degree.global_mobius_effect: C_prim(B)=sum mu(k)C_raw(floor(B/k)) divides the Mellin/Dirichlet singularity by zeta(s), lowering the pole order from 5 to 4.
logarithmic_degree.status: The degrees and candidate constants are the formal main-term architecture. Proving the asymptotics still requires a uniform remainder and a justified Selberg-Delange/Tauberian passage.

repeated_side.possible_equalities: The two first-triangle legs cannot be equal; only c=x or c=y could repeat.
repeated_side.reduction: If z is the repeated leg, then z^2+w^2=p^2 and z^2+p^2=d^2. In the triangle (z,p,d), p is the larger leg and is the hypotenuse of (z,w,p), while the smaller leg z repeats.
repeated_side.nonexistence_input: Zelator, A Non-Existence Property of Pythagorean Triangles with a 3-D Application, arXiv:0903.1280, Theorem 1; equivalently Fermat's right-triangle theorem forbidding square area.
repeated_side.square_area_certificate: Writing u=w/p, t=z/p, v=d/p gives (v+u)^2+(v-u)^2=4 and area ((v+u)(v-u))/2=t^2, a nonzero rational square, contradiction.
repeated_side.conclusion: Repeated-side contribution is exactly zero for every B; hence C_distinct_raw(B)=C_raw(B) identically.

confirmed: The fixed-modulus volume and all local-density factors are explicit.
The modulus Euler product has a cubic singularity.
The formal raw logarithmic degree is 4 and the post-Mobius primitive degree is 3.
Repeated-side subtraction vanishes identically, not merely in the audited range.
decision.next_stage: 12-N1-2g: prove or refute the uniform fixed-modulus lattice remainder needed to upgrade the formal B(log B)^4 raw main term and B(log B)^3 primitive main term to asymptotics.

not_claimed: That the formal raw or primitive asymptotic has been proved.
That the prime-cutoff numerical Euler product is a rigorous enclosure of kappa.
That a currently cited large-sieve theorem supplies the required uniform remainder.
That the primitive oriented asymptotic immediately isolates N1 from exact-two and exact-three multiplicities.
